EARTHLINE_REGIONAL_COVERAGE_AUDIT_16731.densityRule: significant terrain sectors: preferred >=60 => 3 corridors; >=30 => 2; otherwise >=1; exact-cell high-resolution scientific null may explain a lower count

EARTHLINE_SPATIAL_COVERAGE_SELECTION_167.rule: group candidates by the actual clipped corridor midpoint used by the coverage audit, reserve up to three spatially distinct valid terrain-derived candidates per occupied 6x6 sector, then let the existing score/spacing owner fill remaining capacity; science gates and final score ordering are unchanged

EARTHLINE_REFINED_COVERAGE_SELECTION_167.rule: when high-resolution coastal candidates exist, reserve geographically distributed valid candidates before statewide ranking fills remaining capacity

EARTHLINE_COVERAGE_CARRY_16749.rule: when exact-cell refinement is needed, preserve one already-published corridor anchor from every significant covered bin before rerunning selection

EARTHLINE_COVERAGE_GAP_REFINEMENT_16731.rule: refine up to 18 exact jurisdiction cells; one tile transport failure cannot discard successful cells and is never mislabeled as a scientific null

EARTHLINE_REGIONAL_ANALYSIS_EXTENT_16712.rule: use significant true-area components; if one spatial cluster owns >=90% of significant area, remote clusters cannot inflate the analysis envelope

EARTHLINE_VERMONT_PRESELECTION_BOUNDARY_.rule: the same exact VCGI line-clip owner screens Vermont corridors before ranking and verifies them again at final publication
